reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: In src/process.rs, the module owns one AtomicUsize containing the inherited SIGPIPE disposition and one static constructor function pointer.
owner_creation.invariant: Both owned objects have image lifetime.

aliases_escapes.analysis: In src/process.rs, remember_sigpipe uses a stack libc::sigaction; only its scalar sa_sigaction value is copied into the atomic before the stack value expires.
aliases_escapes.invariant: No pointer to the stack sigaction is retained.

callback_targets.analysis: In src/process.rs, rEMEMBER_SIGPIPE names exactly unsafe extern C fn remember_sigpipe(); the ELF init_array invokes it before Rust main, and init calls libc::signal directly.
callback_targets.invariant: Constructor ABI and target are fixed in source.

invalidation.analysis: In src/process.rs, across exec a previous custom handler is reset, leaving DFL or IGN; the saved value remains meaningful through Rust runtime startup.
invalidation.invariant: The saved disposition is an exec-inherited sentinel.

mutation_commit.analysis: In src/process.rs, the constructor stores after successful sigaction lookup; init reads after constructors finish and restores the inherited disposition.
mutation_commit.invariant: Initialization order precedes the restoring read.

release_pair.analysis: In src/process.rs, no handler heap allocation or resource handle is acquired; static function and atomic storage are released with the image.
release_pair.invariant: Signal disposition values are never heap-released.

error_cleanup.analysis: In src/process.rs, failed sigaction lookup leaves the initial DFL value; libc::signal status is ignored, so restoration failure is not reported by this API.
error_cleanup.invariant: Query failure never publishes uninitialized action data.

signals_handoff.analysis: In src/process.rs, the constructor only queries a disposition; init restores SIGPIPE before each executable enters translated application code.
signals_handoff.invariant: No application callback is invoked by the query.
limitations: Supported Linux x86_64 exec startup only; this does not approve runtime.rs signal-sentinel conversions or the remaining signal handler owners.

src/bin/rless.rs.relationship: The executable restores inherited SIGPIPE before it enters pager startup, ordering this process-state owner. Target: FILE:src/process.rs.

src/bin/lessecho.rs.relationship: The companion executable restores SIGPIPE before creating arguments and entering translated helper logic. Target: FILE:src/process.rs.
